'''Gateway Distriparks Limited''' is an Indian [[logistics]] company based in [[Mumbai]] with three business verticals: [[Container terminal|container freight stations]] (CFS), [[Dry port|inland container depots]] (ICD) with rail movement and [[Cold chain|cold chain storage and logistics]]. The company was founded in April 1994 and originally promoted by Newsprint Trading & Sales Corporation (NTSC), CWT Distribution Limited, NUR Investment and Trading Pvt. Ltd., and Intercontinental Forest Products Pte. Ltd. (IFP) as a [[joint venture]] company to conduct the business of [[warehousing]], container freight stations and all related activities. As of November 2015, Prism International Private Limited (same group as NTSC) is the sole promoter of the company.

==Core Business==

GDL operates three core businesses: Container Freight Stations (CFS), Rail-linked Inland Container Depots (ICD) and Cold Chain Storage & Logistics.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gateway Distriparks Ltd (GATE.BO) |url=https://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/company-profile/GATE.BO |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190207020042/https://in.reuters.com/finance/stocks/company-profile/GATE.BO |url-status=dead |archive-date=7 February 2019 |website=[[Reuters]] |publisher=[[Thomson Reuters]] |access-date=6 February 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Gateway Distriparks Ltd. |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/gateway-distr-14744/information/company-history |website=[[Business Standard]] |publisher=Business Standard Ltd. |access-date=6 February 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Gateway Distriparks Ltd; Share Price, Gateway Distriparks |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/company/gateway-distriparks-ltd/summary/14744 |website=[[India Infoline]] |access-date=6 February 2019}}</ref>

===Container Freight Stations (CFS)===
GDL operates Container Freight Stations, located at major Indian ports such as [[Navi Mumbai]], [[Chennai]], [[Visakhapatanam]], and [[Kochi]]. The stations offer container yards, general warehousing, bonded warehousing, empty handling and [[RFID]] technologies used for container tracking. GDL also has its own dedicated fleet of over 25 rakes and 265 trailers for first and last mile connectivity.<ref name="OvGDL">{{cite web |title=Overview of Gateway Distriparks |url=http://be.acespheremf.com/UploadResearch/634726046066563750_Gateway%20Distripark.pdf |website=Balance equity |publisher=InfoRes & Advisors (Consilium) |access-date=6 February 2019 }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref name="GDLS">{{cite news |title=Gateway Distriparks undergoes changes in shareholding pattern |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/gateway-distriparks-undergoes-changes-in-shareholding-pattern/articleshow/50301097.cms |website=[[The Economic Times]] |publisher=[[The Times Group]] |access-date=6 February 2019}}</ref>

===Rail-linked Inland Container Depots (ICD)===
GDL's rail operations are handled by its subsidiary, Gateway Rail Freight Limited. The ICDs are located at [[Garhi Harsaru]] ([[Gurgaon|Gurgaon, Haryana]]), [[Sahnewal]] ([[Ludhiana|Ludhiana, Punjab]]) and [[Faridabad|Faridabad, Haryana]]. In 2010, [[Blackstone Group]] had invested {{INR}}300 crores in GatewayRail, and then in 2019 GDL bought back the entire shareholding from Blackstone.<ref name=":0" /><ref name="auto"/> Company had announced the fifth rail linked container terminal of its subsidiary, Gateway Rail Freight Limited at [[Viramgam]].<ref name="OvGDL"/><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.apherald.com/Business/ViewArticle/261177/Gateway-Rail-to-Start-Handling-Container-Traffic-at-Viramgam/|title=Gateway Rail to Start Handling Container Traffic at Viramgam|work=APHerald [Andhra Pradesh Herald]|access-date=2018-10-19|language=en}}</ref>

===Cold Chain Logistics===
The [[cold chain]] logistics of GDL is run by its subsidiary, Snowman Logistics Limited.<ref>{{cite web |last1=Agaram |first1=Sundar Mangadu |title=Snowman Logistics Limited |url=https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/1378197720977.pdf |website=sebi.gov.in |publisher=[[Securities and Exchange Board of India]] |access-date=6 February 2019}}</ref><ref name="OvGDL"/><ref name="GDLS"/>

extract: Gateway Distriparks Limited is an Indian logistics company based in Mumbai with three business verticals: container freight stations (CFS), inland container depots (ICD) with rail movement and cold chain storage and logistics. The company was founded in April 1994 and originally promoted by Newsprint Trading & Sales Corporation (NTSC), CWT Distribution Limited, NUR Investment and Trading Pvt. Ltd., and Intercontinental Forest Products Pte. Ltd. (IFP) as a joint venture company to conduct the business of warehousing, container freight stations and all related activities. As of November 2015, Prism International Private Limited (same group as NTSC) is the sole promoter of the company.
